items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Rag Baby made me get in the middle. And he got on the outside and he took the bass drum and handed my dad his drum.

ctx.x: That'll dig again. Yeah. And he played, just the, he didn't play the double drums at all.

As you know in those days, even for the dance jobs they used double drums instead of traps. And he had a single dash on his drums. And he played, just the, he didn't play the double drums at all. As you know in those days, even for the dance jobs they used double drums instead of traps. Yeah, with the, with the wire hat band and a hard rubber ball for the beater. And here's a little story that happened in this first parade that I ever played. The parades in those days started at Calliope in St. Charles because…
It didn't burn your foot I guess? Did it burn?
